tradeSequencing.description: Furniture is always the last trade on site. Standard sequence:
sequence: Electrical and data (power to workstation positions, lighting final fix)
AV integration (boardroom screens, VC systems, cable management in table)
IT setup (monitors, docking stations, computers on desks)

buildingAccessRequirements.liftAccess: Confirm minimum dimensions: 2.0m W × 2.0m D × 2.4m H for boardroom tables and large storage units
buildingAccessRequirements.loadingDock: Confirm dock access hours — CBD buildings typically 6am–10am only
buildingAccessRequirements.highRiseDelivery: Levels 5+ often require out-of-hours delivery (before 7am or after 6pm) — add cost premium
buildingAccessRequirements.buildingManagementNotice: Written delivery notification minimum 5 business days in advance
buildingAccessRequirements.lobbyProtection: Carpet runners, lift door pads, and corner guards — non-negotiable on any managed project
buildingAccessRequirements.parkingForInstallers: Confirm street parking or loading zone access — cost additional for CBD locations

builderCoordination.practicalCompletion: Get PC date in writing. Furniture ready for delivery within 5 business days of PC.
builderCoordination.floorFlatness: Check floor flatness for heavy storage units — levelling required if tolerance exceeds 5mm over 2m
builderCoordination.dustEnvironment: Do not install upholstered furniture in an active construction environment — dust embeds permanently
builderCoordination.powerConfirmation: Confirm live power at all workstation positions before final desk installation — cable management depends on active power routing

subcontractorManagement.installationContractors: Use vetted contractors only. For premium projects, use known team. Never use unknown subcontractor on first engagement above $80k.
subcontractorManagement.inductions: Most commercial buildings require SafeWork or similar subcontractor induction. Allow 2–3 business days for processing.
subcontractorManagement.insuranceRequirements: All installation contractors must hold current public liability insurance minimum $10M — verify before engagement
subcontractorManagement.photographyProtocol: Photograph pre-install condition of all floors, walls, lifts, lobbies. Photograph finished installation before handover.

commonSiteRisks: Builder delays pushing PC date — always have a 1-week buffer in timeline
Power/data points misaligned from furniture plan — catch in site measure, not on installation day
Lift unavailable or undersized — confirm early; boardroom tables often exceed lift capacity
Packaging disposal — confirm who removes packing material; building management often prohibits bin dumping
Client adds scope on installation day — any on-day changes must be quoted and approved separately
